question: In an isosceles right-angled triangle, the perimeter is 30 m. Find its area (in m²). (Rounded off to the nearest integral value)
solution:
**Given:**

The perimeter of an isosceles right-angled triangle = 30 m

**Concept used:**

Perimeter of an isosceles triangle = 2x + y

Area of an isosceles right angle triangle = 1/2 × x² × sin θ 

x = equal sides of an isosceles triangle 

θ = angle between equal sides

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51b86c3dca0ca86faceafcdc0e5990f574d91c14714394d722cb2aa72e4e6db0.png] 

In an isosceles right-angled △ ABC, 

⇒ BC² = AB² + AC²

⇒ (y)² = x² + x²

⇒ y = √{2 × (x)²}

⇒ y = √2x<
